name: El Borrego
notes: All 4 photos are chalkboard menus (Starters/Antojitos/House Special, Breakfast/Burritos/Drinks); photos 3-4 are wide shots of the same two boards as 1-2, merged with no duplicate items. Drinks and Sweets section, add-on modifiers, and bulk family-style meat-by-the-pound options were excluded.

dishes.name: Plain Quesadilla
dishes.description: Corn or flour

dishes.name: Taco
dishes.description: One corn soft taco, lamb or pork

dishes.name: Stuffed Quesadilla
dishes.description: Corn; choices squash blossom, rajas, huitlacoche, potato or chorizo, upon availability

dishes.name: Consome de Borrego
dishes.description: 10oz; broth served with rice and chickpeas inside

dishes.name: Ensalada de Nopal
dishes.description: Cactus salad with tomato, onion, cilantro

dishes.name: Fresh Guacamole
dishes.description: Avocado with cilantro, onion, salt and lime

dishes.name: Bean Soup
dishes.description: Pinto bean soup topped with chips, cilantro and cheese

dishes.name: Nachos
dishes.description: Chips with beans, cheese, crema and cilantro; choice of lamb, pork or soyrizo

dishes.name: Sope
dishes.description: Thick tortilla with meat and toppings - beans, lettuce, cream, cheese; choice of chicken, potato, chorizo, pork, lamb or soyrizo

dishes.name: Enchiladas
dishes.description: 2 enchiladas, chicken or cheese, with cheese on top, rice and beans; one salsa - red, green or mole

dishes.name: Roll Tacos
dishes.description: Order of 3 roll tacos with rice, choice of chicken, lamb or potato, topped with crema and cheese

dishes.name: Lamb Special
dishes.description: Combination of 1 lamb taco, 1 roll lamb taco, 1 quesadilla, rice and salad

dishes.name: Mixiote de Borrego
dishes.description: Marinated lamb meat simmered for hours, super tender and juicy, includes 6 tortillas, cilantro, onion, salsas for tacos

dishes.name: Green Pozole
dishes.description: Only Thursday to Sunday; pork pozole from Guerrero, Mexico, made with pumpkin seeds, includes tostada, pork cracklins, radish and cabbage; vegan green pozole available on request

dishes.name: Chilaquiles
dishes.description: Green, red or house mole; homemade chips soaked in salsa covered in cream and cheese, beans on the side

dishes.name: Huevos Rancheros
dishes.description: 2 eggs over easy covered in ranchero sauce, with rice, beans and 2 tortillas

dishes.name: Huevos Revueltos
dishes.description: 3 scrambled eggs with beans, rice and 2 tortillas; choice of soyrizo, pork chorizo and potatoes, lamb barbacoa, or cactus and onions

dishes.name: Toluca Burrito
dishes.description: 14 inch flour tortilla with chips; pork chorizo with potatoes, eggs, beans and cheese, option of soyrizo

dishes.name: Jimador Burrito
dishes.description: 14 inch flour tortilla with chips; carne asada, rice and beans, optional cilantro and onion

dishes.name: Borrego Burrito
dishes.description: 14 inch flour tortilla with chips; juicy tender lamb meat, pinto beans, rice and salsa
